description: Un caballero no se mide por la fuerza de sus ataques, sino por el coraje de su corazón.
summary: Flame in Freefall makes NASA microgravity combustion data searchable and comparable. Explore 23 source tables, inspect BASS-II trials and original recordings, and ask questions that return cited NASA evidence. The dashboard supports fire-safety research and future test planning.
details:
Fire research for future spacecraft draws on experiments with different materials, pressures, oxygen concentrations and ventilation. A useful comparison needs the conditions behind each result. Flame in Freefall gives researchers and reviewers a place to explore those conditions and follow the evidence to its source.

The PSI explorer exposes 23 experimental CSV tables from 21 investigations. Its 2,016 source rows include tests, samples, notes, sessions, configuration entries and references. Search and export retain the original units, file and row identifiers, including blanks and repeat references. For BASS-II, we match experiment and sample IDs to Appendix A of NASA/TM-20210011385. Of 129 BASS-II records, 126 link to report entries. The map shows 25 trial records with usable single-valued airflow readings and calibrated initial oxygen. The comparator displays differences and missing values, and links to 53 recordings across 23 trials. The investigation overview ranks studies by team-assessed relevance to prevention, detection and suppression. The app also displays specialist views for FLEX and Saffire-II.

The assistant indexes the BASS-II report and NASA's combustion science guide, including page-level chunks and linked trial observations. When available, it combines BM25 keyword retrieval and embedding similarity using reciprocal rank fusion. Questions about named trials can route directly to the corresponding report entries. The worker requests structured evidence IDs from the OpenAI model, validates the cited IDs and links to the original pages. When generation is unavailable, users can still search the documents. The broader CSV catalog remains directly explorable and has a separate ingestion path.

As an example, the assistant linked the quick extinction after airflow was cut in B1 to NASA's Table A.1, p. 103. In a separate thin-PMMA series at 1 atm, NASA measured opposed-flow extinction velocities of 10 ± 5 mm/s at 21% oxygen and 30 ± 5 mm/s at 16% oxygen (Table 2.1, p. 28). These measurements describe those conditions. The tool leaves 101 of 129 BASS-II flame-spread outcomes unknown and withholds a lunar spread rate when the cited tests do not cover lunar gravity.

The project recorded 10/10 local acceptance cases in each of document search and AI generation. Three live generation checks separately verified trial, hybrid and lunar-scope routing. We also verified all 23 export tables against 2,016 source rows. These are targeted functional checks. The dashboard supports research reviews and test planning. Future work can extend report linkage, test on an independent set of questions and incorporate matched partial-gravity evidence. The public repository includes the Python importers, browser source and Node.js server. It can run locally with document search without an API key.
